_comment: Which part of you took the angle, by natal point then tone.
These used to be slot 2 of the card body: a clause wedged between the
reading and the timing, written to open with a back-reference so it would
parse after any of the 225 openings it could follow. Two failures came
out of that. The pronoun collided, because the opening had usually spent
its own 'it' on something else: 'Pay the boring bill first. It is the one
that turns into a larger problem if it waits. It is your sense of
yourself under the pressure.' And the clause was written about the chart
rather than about the reader, so a third of every paragraph was the
So these are now the second paragraph of the expanded card, where there
is room for them. Each one is self-contained, addressed to the reader,
and has to advance the reading rather than restate it. No back-reference
opening, no 'It is'. They answer one question: which part of you this
landed on, and what that means for the next few hours.

sun.charged: This landed on your sense of yourself, which is why it feels personal rather than practical. Being seen accurately matters more than usual today, and being read wrongly costs more than it should.
sun.open: This reached the part of you that wants to be recognised, and today that part has room in it. Say what you want to be known for while it is easy to say.
sun.friction: The pressure is on your sense of yourself, so almost anything said today will read as criticism where none is meant. Assume it is not about you, and check tomorrow when it has cooled.
sun.easy: Your sense of yourself is steady underneath all this, which is why none of it costs much. You can afford to hear the whole of what somebody says today without flinching at it.
sun.pull: Your sense of yourself is on one end of this and something else is on the other. You cannot satisfy both. Decide which one you would defend, and let the other one wait.

moon.charged: This landed on your mood rather than your judgement, and the mood arrives several minutes before the reasoning does. Give yourself that gap today before you answer anything that matters.
moon.open: What you need is easier to say than usual today, and easier for somebody to hear. Say it plainly, once, and do not build a case around it first.
moon.friction: The strain is on your need for things to be settled. The unsettledness is temporary and your reaction to it is out of proportion. Do something physical and dull for an hour.
moon.easy: Your footing is good today, so you can afford to feel the whole of something rather than managing it. Let the feeling run its full length instead of cutting it short.
moon.pull: What you need and what is being asked of you are at opposite ends of this. Say the need out loud, rather than performing it and hoping somebody notices.

mercury.charged: This landed on how you put things, so the wording matters more today than the point does. Choose the sentence carefully, and then say it exactly once.
mercury.open: The words are unusually available today. Use them on the thing that has been hard to explain, not on the conversation that was going to be easy anyway.
mercury.friction: The strain is on how you say things rather than on what you mean. The gap between those two is wider today, so check before you assume you were understood.
mercury.easy: The saying is the easy part today. Whatever you have not been able to phrase will come out cleanly, so have the conversation while that is still true.
mercury.pull: Two things you want to say are pulling in different directions, and a sentence containing both will please nobody. Say the more important one and drop the other.

venus.charged: This landed on what you want, which is why it feels less like a decision than usual. Notice that wanting something and it being good for you are separate questions.
venus.open: What you are drawn to is unusually accessible today. Move towards it in a small way rather than waiting for a version that arrives fully formed.
venus.friction: The strain is on what you want, and today wanting is uncomfortable rather than pleasant. Do not resolve that by buying something or by making a promise you will reread later.
venus.easy: What you are drawn to and what is actually available line up today, which does not happen often. Take the pleasant thing without needing to have earned it first.
venus.pull: What you want and what you are supposed to want are at opposite ends of this. Say the true one to yourself before you say the acceptable one to anybody else.

mars.charged: This landed on your drive, which is why the reaction is arriving ahead of the thought. The push is real and the first thing it aims at is usually the wrong target.
mars.open: The push is available today without having to be forced. Point it at the thing that needs starting rather than at the thing that needs winning.
mars.friction: The strain is on your drive, so frustration is arriving early and out of proportion. Move your body before you make any decision that involves another person.
mars.easy: The push is there and it is not costing you anything today. Use it on the task you have been putting off, rather than on the one that was already moving.
mars.pull: Your drive and something else are pulling opposite ways, which is why you feel busy and stationary at the same time. Stop one of the two rather than working harder at both.

jupiter.charged: This landed on your appetite for more, and today that appetite is louder than your judgement. The instinct to expand is worth listening to and not worth acting on before evening.
jupiter.open: The part of you that wants more room has some today. Ask for the larger version of what you were going to ask for, since the difference in cost is small.
jupiter.friction: The strain is on your optimism, which has been promising things the schedule cannot cover. Cut the plan by a third today and it turns into something that actually happens.
jupiter.easy: Room opens easily today and the temptation is to fill it immediately. Take the opportunity, and leave some of the space unspent.
jupiter.pull: Growth and what you already have are at opposite ends of this. Expanding costs you something real, and today is a good day to say out loud what it costs.

saturn.charged: This landed on the part of you that keeps promises, so today feels heavier than the tasks warrant. The weight is the point rather than a problem to be solved.
saturn.open: The discipline is available today without the usual argument about it. Start the thing that needs consistency, since starting is the expensive part of it.
saturn.friction: The strain is on your patience, and the limit is real rather than a failure of will. Do less today, properly, and stop treating your capacity as a moral question.
saturn.easy: Structure comes easily today. Build the boring system now, while it costs almost nothing, and it will hold on the days when it would cost a lot.
saturn.pull: What you owe and what you want are at opposite ends of this. The obligation is real. So is the resentment, and today is the day to say which one you are choosing.

uranus.charged: This landed on the part of you that will not settle. The urge to change something suddenly is strong today, and it is rarely aimed at the right thing.
uranus.open: There is room to do it differently today, with less resistance than usual. Change one small thing rather than announcing a new way of working.
uranus.friction: The strain is on your need for room to move, which is why ordinary constraints feel intolerable today. Do not resign from anything before the weekend.
uranus.easy: A change that would normally be disruptive is cheap today. Make the alteration you have been circling, and make it small enough to be reversible.
uranus.pull: Freedom and commitment are at opposite ends of this, and both of them are yours. Naming the trade today prevents the version where you break something to avoid saying it.

neptune.charged: This landed on the part of you that softens the edges, so the story you tell yourself is more persuasive than usual today. Check the facts before acting on the feeling.
neptune.open: Your imagination is unusually available today, and unusually accurate. Use it on something that benefits from it, and keep it well away from the arithmetic.
neptune.friction: The strain is on your sense of what is actually happening. Things are less clear than they feel today, in both directions. Postpone anything that needs a firm number.
neptune.easy: The soft focus is working for you today rather than against you. Let the ambiguity sit rather than forcing it into a decision this afternoon.
neptune.pull: What you hope is true and what you can see are at opposite ends of this. Both are informing you. Only one of them should be signing anything.

pluto.charged: This landed on the part of you that does not do things by halves. What it touches gets changed rather than adjusted, which is worth knowing before you start.
pluto.open: There is a way through something entrenched today, and it is available rather than easy. Take the smaller version of the confrontation while the door is open.
pluto.friction: The strain is on the part of you that holds on hardest. The grip will not be argued away today. Notice what you are protecting before you defend it again.
pluto.easy: Something normally immovable will move today if you push steadily at it. Pick the entrenched thing rather than the convenient one.
pluto.pull: Control and letting go are at opposite ends of this, and both of them feel like survival. You will not settle it today. Say what you are actually afraid of losing.

ascendant.charged: This landed on how you come across, which is the first thing anybody gets from you and the hardest to correct afterwards. Whatever you lead with today is what people take away.
ascendant.open: How you come across is easy to steer today. Turn up as you are rather than as the arranged version, and it will be received better than usual.
ascendant.friction: The strain is in the gap between how you meant to land and how you did. That gap is wider today, so ask rather than assuming you were read correctly.
ascendant.easy: You land well today with very little effort. Spend that on a room you have been avoiding, rather than on the one where you are already comfortable.
ascendant.pull: How you appear and how you actually are have come apart today. Do not fix that by performing harder. Say the plainer thing and let the appearance catch up.

midheaven.charged: This landed on your standing, which means it plays out in public rather than privately. What becomes visible today is what gets remembered, so choose what you make visible.
midheaven.open: Your standing has room in it today. Ask for the thing that changes what people think you do, because that ask is unusually cheap this morning.
midheaven.friction: The strain is on your reputation rather than on your work. Those are different problems and only one of them is fixed by working harder. Go and talk to somebody.
midheaven.easy: What you are seen doing and what you are actually doing line up today. Take the credit while that is true, plainly and without a speech attached.
midheaven.pull: What you do and what you are known for have come apart. Both are real. Decide which one you want to be true a year from now, and give that one the better hours.
